summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] entry in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not verified: test results and Black formatting, since I was instructed not to run anything. Nothing committed.
